findings.sentence: Here is the truth, plain, because you deserve it plain: when a teacher preached in our own cities what we judged a false gospel, we answered him by name - Bardaisan, Marcion, Mani - and our sharpest voice folded all three into a single word, deception, more polemic than fair portrait.
